rubric.role_summary: Senior cryogenic systems engineering role developing compact millikelvin cryocooler systems from concept through design, assembly, testing, certification, and delivery, including low-temperature system integration.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior cryogenic systems engineering role developing compact millikelvin cryocooler systems from concept through design, assembly, testing, certification, and delivery, including low-temperature system integration.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 10+ years’ experience in cryogenic system design.
- Experience with cryostat design or low-temperature system integration.
- Experience with GM, pulse tube, and/or Joule-Thomson cryocoolers.
- CFD and/or thermal modelling experience.
- Knowledge of CAD systems, including basic 3D CAD for component design.
- Practical understanding of vacuum systems, helium systems, assembly methodologies, and temperature control.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience with turbo pumps and/or cryogenic turbocompressor design.
- Experience with CTE analysis and cooling cycle design.
- Experience supporting certification of complex technical equipment.
- Experience with sub-4K cryostat design and low-temperature system integration.
- Knowledge of the He-4 / He-3 phase diagram and cryogenic cooling cycles.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: California. This is the role's single location rule: candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
